title: fix(app-shell): Studio's flow start node stops offering 「Platform event」, a trigger no engine routes (objectui#11067)
body:
Fixes #11067
Clause-②: no

Studio's flow start-node inspector offered a 「Platform event」 trigger that wrote `triggerType: 'event'`. The spec's `resolveFlowTriggerKind` answers no trigger kind for that token, and no engine trigger binds it, so a flow authored with it never fired and nothing said so. Implemented along triage's direction (comment 5887202725): remove the option, don't invent the route.

## What changed

- **The option is gone.** The `start` inspector's Trigger select no longer offers 「Platform event」. A comment beside the objectui#11054 `api` note says why.
- **The two start-node gates stop naming `event`.** The Object and Entry condition fields no longer appear for that token alone. A value already stored on such a node stays on screen under the existing stored-value re-show rule, flagged as retained.
- **A stored `event` is not rewritten.** Nothing new was built for it. The select already shows a stored value it does not offer as a flagged, selectable row: `InspectorSelectField` owns that rule (objectui#8488), and the flow select branch words the flag through `flagUnknownValue` with the catalogue key `engine.form.deprecated`. A save keeps the value as stored.
- **The zh overlay drops the option's label** (`FLOW_FIELD_ZH`, the start node's `triggerType` options). See the next section.

## Beyond the claim's file surface: one line in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`

The claim names `flow-node-config.ts`. The option's zh label lives in the zh overlay in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, and `localizeField` reads an overlay label only through an offered option. Once the option leaves, its label is read by nothing. The one-line removal is the zh half of the same option declaration. It follows the precedent of PR objectui#11064, which swapped the overlay's `webhook` key for `api` in the same change. It meets the four conditions for an in-place fix:

1. It is the same defect class.
2. It is mechanical.
3. The in-flight PR objectui#11084 does not touch the file. Its REST file list has 10 files, none of them `i18n.ts`.
4. It adds no verification surface beyond this PR's app-shell tests and type-check.

A pin states the rule rather than the one token: every zh overlay key for the trigger select names an offered option. Ablation A3 below shows that pin going red when the label is put back.

## Measured before building

- **The resolver**, probed with installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0. `triggerType: 'event'` gives `undefined`. So does `event` with an `objectName`. The control `api` gives `api`. objectstack `origin/main` `b80ab579` has the same `resolveFlowTriggerKind`, and `FLOW_TRIGGER_KINDS` there is `record_change`, `time_relative`, `schedule` and `api`.
- **The flag exists, so there is no new UI element and no new string.** No locale-pack key was added, so the pack serialisation behind objectui#11056 does not apply. That card has also since merged as `873284657`, this branch's base.
- **Census of stored `triggerType: 'event'`: zero.** The pattern allows an optional quote around the key, then a colon, then the token quoted or bare.
  - objectui `873284657`, all tracked files: `event` 0. Lit controls on the same shape: `api` 21 hits in 4 files, `record-` 13 hits in 8 files.
  - objectstack `b80ab579`, `examples/`: `event` 0. Controls: `api` 1 hit (the showcase inbound flow), `record-` 22 hits in 5 files.
  - objectstack `b80ab579`, whole tree: `event` 1 hit. It is not the token: `triggerType: event` is a JS variable in `trigger-record-change`'s `bulk-write-per-row-context.test.ts`.
  - The wording 「Platform event」 appears nowhere else in objectui (case-insensitive, all tracked files).
- **Nothing publishes a `start` node configSchema** that could put the option back. objectstack `service-automation`'s builtin node forms carry no `start` node, and the inspector's field table for `start` is this repo's own.

## Pins

- `flow-node-config.platformEvent-11067.test.ts` (table half):
  - the resolver answers no kind for `event`, with an `api` control;
  - no option writes `event`, and no start field is gated on it;
  - every value a start field is gated on is one the select offers;
  - the zh overlay labels only offered options;
  - a stored `event` no longer shows the Object and Entry condition fields on the token alone, and a stored `objectName` beside it stays visible, flagged `controller-off`, with a live record-trigger control.
- `FlowNodeInspector.platformEvent-11067.test.tsx` (what the author sees):
  - the open list has no such row, with a `Webhook / API` control;
  - in en-US and zh-CN, a stored `event` draws the value under the flag. The expected text is built with the same `flagUnknownValue` and catalogue key, so the wording is not pinned here. `unknownValueFlag.i18n-9652.test.tsx` owns the wording.
  - the flagged row is selectable;
  - an edit that does not touch the select saves `{ triggerType: 'event' }` and `{ triggerType: 'event', objectName: 'task' }` back unchanged.

## Ablations

Run at `c5ebc3d93` (the fix and pins committed). Each leg went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. That tool checks that the anchor hit exactly once, that the blob changed, and that the restore proof holds: blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. Each red/green split was predicted before the run.

| Leg | Mutation | Predicted | Observed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | the option row put back | 5 red, 8 green | `Tests  5 failed \| 8 passed (13)` |
| A2 | `'event'` put back on the Object gate | 4 red, 9 green | `Tests  4 failed \| 9 passed (13)` |
| A3 | the zh overlay label put back | 1 red, 12 green | `Tests  1 failed \| 12 passed (13)` |

The A3 mutant's blob is `98a9c7936`. That is the base file's own blob, so the leg restored the old line byte for byte. The two round-trip cases stay green in every leg, which was predicted: no leg moves the save path. They guard a future rewrite of a stored value, and none of the three mutations exercises that.

## Gates

The final head is `4de4b51ea`. It differs from `c5ebc3d93` by one test-only line: `readOnly={false}` on the new inspector pin's mount.

- **Build.** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`, run at `c5ebc3d93`. The dependency closure has no diff.
- **Type-check at `4de4b51ea`.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0. It runs `tsc --noEmit`, then `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose `include` is `src/**/*.test.ts` and `src/**/*.test.tsx`. At `c5ebc3d93` the test project refused the new inspector pin's mount for a missing required `readOnly` prop. That red is how we know the test project reads the new file. `4de4b51ea` is that repair.
- **Tests at `c5ebc3d93`.** `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/`: `Test Files  111 passed (111)` and `Tests  1554 passed | 1 skipped (1555)`.
- **Tests at `4de4b51ea`.** The two new pin files plus the two objectui#11054 pin files: `Test Files  4 passed (4)` and `Tests  42 passed (42)`.
- **Other gates at `4de4b51ea`, each exit 0:**
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`;
  - `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs`;
  - `check:new-line-citations`, which reports 0 new;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape`;
  - `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:i18n-designer-parity` and `check:i18n-drift`;
  - `check:designer-field-key-parity`. It is run anyway, although no field key moved.

A declared narrowing: the full `vitest` farm and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` belong to CI.

- ESLint read the 4 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files. That count comes from `--format json`: 4 results, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `eslint.config.js` sets no `projectService` and no `parserOptions.project`, so type-aware linting is off. This diff therefore cannot move a lint verdict on a file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- `FLOW_META_ZH.type` (the canvas header pill for the flow-level `type`) still carries `event: '平台事件'`, and also `webhook`, `manual` and `time_relative`. It is a display fallback for a stored flow-level value, not an option anyone picks, and is outside this card. The installed spec's flow `type` enum is `autolaunched`, `record_change`, `schedule`, `screen` and `api`. Carrier: none.
- This is a read, not a measurement: objectstack's `validate-flow-trigger-readiness` reports an off-grammar `triggerType` only on a `type: 'record_change'` flow. Whether `os validate` says anything about `triggerType: 'event'` on an `autolaunched` flow was not run. After this PR, the census finds no producer of the token. Carrier: none.
